name: Christian Brothers University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate for all students. 2026-27 Day Program from cbu.edu/admissions-aid/financial-aid/tuition-fees/: tuition $19,875/semester ($39,750/yr) + student service fee $595/semester ($1,190/yr) = $40,940 tuition & fees/yr. Housing published only as combined room + board; lowest standard undergrad option (Maurelian/Rozier Hall Double + All Access Meal Plan) $4,915/semester = $9,830/yr. No room-only rate published.
